title: BUGFIX — Achiri uses OLLAMA_URL but env only has OLLAMA_HOST
rationale: agents/achiri/index.ts:318 uses OLLAMA_URL env var which is never set. All other agents use OLLAMA_HOST (which IS set via Tailscale to vault). Achiri falls back to localhost:11434, which times out when Ollama is on the remote vault. Root cause of 'chat() error (timeout): DOMException [AbortError]' in logs. Fix: one-line change to use OLLAMA_HOST consistently.

tasks.description: agents/achiri/index.ts line ~318: change OLLAMA_URL to OLLAMA_HOST with http:// prefix normalization (same pattern as other agents).
